topic: Sandbox your AI agent and see what it touches (Airlock)
title: Airlock: see what your AI agent touches
description: Airlock sandbox for AI agents: run Claude Code or Codex in a VM and watch every file it touches. You'll learn how to sandbox an AI agent on your Mac tonight. Full how-to in the description. (Narration is AI-generated.)
hook_candidates: Your agent's allow button is blind.
Airlock watches what your agent touches.
The curl hid inside the build script.
Airlock: a fence with a window.
Your agent, but on a leash.
narration_full: Yesterday, Simon Maddox caged his Claude and Codex agents with Airlock. His free Mac app is the cage. You click allow on every prompt, and the box only ever sees the command. Never what the script did. By allow-click forty, you're not reading. Airlock runs your agent in a virtual machine, a second computer inside your Mac, on a project copy. A live timeline lists every process, file and server. Changes return as a diff, a before-and-after per file you tick. Catch: a cage, not a conscience. Public servers stay reachable. Tonight, on Apple silicon with macOS twenty-six or later, a brew install gets you airlock run claude. Watch before you tick.
